def cache_sim(capacity, ttl, ops):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    # OrderedDict to maintain insertion/access order (most recently used at end)
    cache = OrderedDict()
    # Dictionary to store write times for expiry checking
    write_times = {}
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == 'put':
            _, t, key, value = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k in cache if write_times[k] + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
                del write_times[k]
            
            # If key already exists, remove it (will be re-added as most recent)
            if key in cache:
                del cache[key]
            
            # If cache is at capacity, evict least recently used
            if len(cache) >= capacity:
                lru_key, _ = cache.popitem(last=False)
                del write_times[lru_key]
            
            # Add the new entry
            cache[key] = value
            write_times[key] = t
        
        elif op[0] == 'get':
            _, t, key = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k in cache if write_times[k] + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
                del write_times[k]
            
            # Check if key exists and return value or -1
            if key in cache:
                value = cache[key]
                # Move to end (most recently used)
                cache.move_to_end(key)
                results.append(value)
            else:
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
